taste:
This is a mild, sweet-savoury curry built around the contrast between crisp panko breadcrumbs and smooth sauce. The chicken breast escalope is sliced, then generously covered with a rich, aromatic curry sauce. Its gentle spice makes it a better fit for someone seeking warmth and sweetness than a strong chilli-led flavour. The coating supplies the crunch, while the chicken underneath is described as succulent.

Served hot with sticky basmati rice alongside, the plate brings together distinct textures rather than relying on heat for interest. Expect the sauce to be a prominent part of each mouthful, not a small accompaniment. The Japanese-inspired style offers an alternative to traditional British curries.
